summary: Avalon GloboCare Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of two promissory notes: on June 1, 2026, a $250,000 note (with $50,000 OID) to Dune Equity Holdings LLC for $200,000 net proceeds, and on June 2, 2026, a similar $250,000 note to FirstFire Global Opportunities Fund LLC. Terms include 18.75% interest fee, four monthly principal payments starting September 2026, default interest at 10%, a most-favored-nations clause, and 25% of net proceeds from equity/debt/asset sales to repay notes. A side letter grants Hudson Global Ventures a right of first refusal on equity line transactions. This is routine debt financing for working capital, not a special situation.
